findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. This checks the published `ready` field but never checks `clean_reviews`. A clean review can be published before `checks.wait` finishes; if the check fails, close publishes that review without writing a receipt. When the same commit's checks later pass, both board and next still show it as in progress, although the shared record contains its clean review.
